events.verdict: Sexton (UTA) legally contests Hunter's (ATL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Markkanen (UTA) firms up in a screening position in Young's (ATL) path and does not deliver contact. As he releases, he places his arm against him but does not push off to create space.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Sexton's (UTA) driving shot attempt.
Sexton (UTA) reaches in towards the ball and the contact with Young's (ATL) body is marginal.
Hunter (ATL) establishes himself in Sexton's (UTA) path and absorbs the contact as they come together. The two players briefly engage and separate following the pick.
Markkanen (UTA) moves alongside Young's (ATL) path legally contests the driving shot attempt.
Markkanen (UTA) extends his arm into Young (ATL) after turning and delivering contact during the pick.
Markkanen (UTA) rests his hands on Hunter's (ATL) body as he moves to set the pick and he allows him to move freely.
Williams (UTA) legally contests Hunter's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Bogdanovic (ATL) is in bounds when he receives the pass.
Sexton (UTA) initiates illegal contact to Young (ATL) that affects his SQBR.
Williams (UTA) briefly places an arm around Hunter (ATL) before immediately removing it and deflecting the ball away.
Williams (UTA) deflects the throw-in out of bounds.
Williams (UTA) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Daniels (ATL) briefly engages with Kessler (UTA) and immediately releases as he reaches for the ball.
Krejci (ATL) legally contests Sexton's (UTA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Sexton (UTA) legally contests Young's (ATL) last second shot attempt.
